name: ai-chatbot-saas
description: Multi-tenant AI customer support chatbot platform (monorepo root)

scripts.worker:dev: uv run --directory services/api celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --pool=solo --queues=default,ingest,crawl,chat_out,billing --loglevel=INFO
scripts.api:lint: uv run --directory services/api ruff check . && uv run --directory services/api ruff format --check .
scripts.api:format: uv run --directory services/api ruff format . && uv run --directory services/api ruff check --fix .
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm api:lint && pnpm api:typecheck && pnpm api:test
